purpose: Blind multiscale search for reproducible astrophysical structure and anomalies in public multi-band imagery, extending the Janus Cristal methodology.
analysis_modes: temporal persistence where repeated observations exist

allowed: propose scale/orientation/trajectory families before outcome inspection
forbidden: claiming discovery from planner enrichment alone

prediction_before_search.expected: Most high-scoring structures will be ordinary astrophysical morphology, instrumental artifacts, processing artifacts, or known object classes.
prediction_before_search.scientifically_interesting: A small number of anomalies may survive multiple bands, null models, and independent objects.
prediction_before_search.hidden_message_probability_assumption: No semantic or extraterrestrial-message hypothesis is admitted by this gate.

candidate_admission.minimum: candidate must survive preregistered null test and independent re-evaluation
candidate_admission.strong: candidate must replicate on an independent object or observation
candidate_admission.semantic_gate: closed until physical/morphological replication is established

success_definition: Discovery of a reproducible, previously under-characterized astrophysical or imaging structure; not merely visual resemblance.
failure_definition: Planner enrichment that fails null/replication gates is closed as non-discovery.
claim_ceiling: This manifest can establish only reproducible image/data-level anomalies. It cannot establish extraterrestrial intelligence, hidden messages, or unknown physics without independent domain-specific evidence.
